visual_text: Score the pain when moving, too
After surgery, pain on movement was about 2 to 3 times as high as pain at rest in the first 3 days, in trials that measured both. The trials were not specifically in older people.
Pain at rest: ask while lying or sitting
Pain on standing, turning or walking: ask during the movement
Can't describe pain? Watch the face and body during movement or care
Ask: what is stopping you from doing what you want to do?
Srikandarajah and Gilron, Pain 2011; Schofield, Age Ageing 2018
alt_text: Hospital bay drawing with numbered markers: an older woman lying in bed, and the same woman standing with a walking frame beside a physiotherapist. Key: ask pain at rest, ask during movement, watch face and body if she cannot say, ask what stops her. Pain on movement was 2 to 3 times rest pain after surgery.
